primitive.relation: one contract: the path graph P_n on the ordinals 'I_n, two indices adjacent exactly when they are consecutive in either order, with n vertices, no loop, no modular wrap and no positivity premise. Relations: Hom.U3.pth_rel (Section parameter n) and Chromatic.X170.x170_p4_edge (n = 4) are the raw relation GTBase.path_graphs.ordinal_path_rel by conversion; Packing.X18.x18_path_rel and Packing.X226.x226_path_rel carry a redundant (i != j) guard and are pointwise equal to it (ordinal_path_rel_guardedE), not convertible. Constructors: Hom.U3.path_graph, Packing.X18.x18_path_graph and Packing.X226.x226_path_graph were SGraph packagings of those relations with their own symmetry/irreflexivity proofs; each is isomorphic to the canonical ordinal_path through upstream eq_diso (the identity on 'I_n), and no proof-term conversion is claimed. GTBase.path_graphs is a focused construction module: the raw relation and the SGraph constructor, the raw and guarded edge equations, order n, no loop, the small cases n = 0, 1, 2, 3, the P_4 instance, and bridges (maximum degree at most two, connected, a forest by K3_free_forest, hence a tree and a B9 path_tree). Distinct, untouched: the cyclic GTBase.base.cyc_rel / cycle_graph, Minor.X198.x198_join_path_rel on a sum carrier, the other cyclic/modular, product and directed relations listed in the spec, sequence paths and path indices, and B9's degree-bounded predicate path_tree.

ordinal-path-relation.note: consecutive ordinals in either order: Hom and X170 raw (conversion), Packing guarded by i != j (pointwise equality through ordinal_path_rel_guardedE). The X170 intermediaries x170_induced_oriented_P4 / x170_forb_oriented_P4_family and the blocked row oriented_P4_forb_chi_bounded_statement are frozen over the frozen relation with a complete pre-C9/B21 Original over C9's frozen X170Legacy.x170_chi_bounded; the row's known-unfaithful exceptional set stays blocked and unrepaired.

ordinal-path-graph.note: SGraph packagings of the relations above with their own proof fields, each isomorphic (diso, identity on 'I_n) to GTBase.path_graphs.ordinal_path through upstream eq_diso; the frozen proof lemmas are certified by the *_proofs_compat isomorphisms. Complete rows frozen over the frozen constructors: Packing X18 path_partition_independent_set_balance_statement (independence transports along the pointwise edge equality), Packing X226 eta_bounded_path_free_classes_statement (induced-freeness along the isomorphism), Hom U3 extremal_problem_on_the_number_of_tree_endomorphism_statement (the endomorphism counts agree by conversion).

upstream_audit.note: coq-graph-theory 0.9.7 has the SGraph constructor, eq_diso (pointwise equal relations give isomorphic graphs), the complete graphs, KB, sjoin, add_node, compl and del_edges, and Path / upath for walks inside a graph, but no concrete path graph on ordinals; GTBase.base has the cyclic cyc_rel / cycle_graph only. The canonical constructor is therefore new in GTBase.path_graphs, built from upstream SGraph, compared with the migrated constructors through eq_diso and bridged to upstream is_forest / is_tree through K3_free_forest and connectedTI, and to B9's path_tree.
